steps: Sign up at api-portal.tfl.gov.uk/signup and activate your account via the confirmation email.
Sign in, open the Products section and subscribe to the '500 Requests per min' product.
After subscribing you are taken to your Profile, where your subscription keys are listed.
x-openmapx-setup.cost: Free. Anonymous access is capped at 50 req/min; a registered key raises this to 500 req/min.
x-openmapx-setup.notes: The key is appended to requests as the app_key query parameter.
